scope: Deterministic offline software attack benchmark of the existing vehicle policy; no dataset-to-physical-IMU mapping, no new model or threshold.
design_status: Fixed before this benchmark execution; designed after observing earlier policy tests. Not an independently preregistered or held-out evaluation.
comparators_kind: Engineering ablations of this implementation, not published-method baselines.
source_contract: Production PolicyConfig: 500ms collector TTL, 50ms intersource skew, 250ms capability lease. These application defaults are separate from the 100ms speed-model source-clock budget and provide no physical safety bound.
threats: Unauthenticated source changes, signed faulty/compromised collectors, replay, clock anomalies, missing/malformed evidence, scope changes, capability lifecycle abuse. HMAC keys are deterministic public test fixtures only.
denominators: Every profile x every listed case x every comparator is retained. Any ALLOW or RESTRICT is an access grant. Capability consumption is scored separately. No IID inference, p-value, physical attack detection rate, human evaluation, or latency guarantee.
known_limitations: Common signed GNSS and wheel speed shifts preserve pairwise agreement and may grant.
Replay and used-token state are process-local; restarting with the same keys loses that history.
Synthetic clean profiles do not estimate real-drive availability.
Successful cryptographic verification does not authenticate physical measurements.
